description: Sets the contrast of Rack's own menus and tooltips; it has no jacks and makes no sound
notes: the module changes nothing until you pick one of the three schemes from its right-click menu.
the scheme it sets is the contrast of Rack's own menus and tooltips everywhere, not the look of this panel.
the scheme last picked stays in force after the module is deleted, until Rack is restarted or another Contrast module sets it back.
menu: Default — puts Rack's menu and tooltip colours back as they were
High Contrast Light — draws Rack's menus and tooltips as dark lettering on a light ground
High Contrast Dark — draws Rack's menus and tooltips as light lettering on a dark ground
